verdict.rationale: Airweave's agentic search can 'navigate entity hierarchies (parent/child/sibling)' during retrieval, which hints at some structured entity relationships, but there is no documentation of a true knowledge-graph store, explicit relationship modeling, or multi-hop graph traversal for entity-centric queries. Missing for 10: explicit graph database/schema of entities and relationships, multi-hop query support, and any documentation or examples of multi-hop entity-centric question answering.
